newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RUGBY UNION-CAREL DU PLESSIS NEW SPRINGBOK RUGBY COACH.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-CAREL DU PLESSIS NEW SPRINGBOK RUGBY COACH.

text.p: Carel du Plessis, 36, regarded as one of the greatest wings in the history of South African rugby, was named in Cape Town on Tuesday as the new coach of the national Springboks team to succeed disgraced Andre Markgraaff.

Du Plessis has never coached a club or provincial side but accompanied the Springboks end of season tour of Argentina and Europe as a tactical adviser. His appointment was announced by South African Rugby Football Union spokesman Alex Broun.
Markgraaff resigned last week after admitting making insulting racial remarks about black sports officials in a secretly taped conversation.
